parameterization.coverage: Changed local modules + transitive imports must be covered; omitted module, empty bundle/scenarios, wildcard expansion or source drift rejects the run.

ADMISSION.additional_modules: Admission fixture and every transitive dependency explicitly pinned before run

FIX_BUNDLE.additional_modules: Every fix module plus transitive closure

P2_STATE_CONTRACT.additional_modules: P2 AC-18 test and state-contract fixture are pinned by the exact completion bundle; no transport or provider module is in scope.

P2B.additional_modules: The capability-limited VM executes the actual intent store and dedicated AC-10 scenario. The node:test router-adapter suite remains a separately pinned regression because node:test cannot execute inside the builtin-denying VM allowlist. Both suites must preserve the same seven AC-10 assertion IDs; a semantic change requires updating and rerunning both.

STORE_DRIVER.additional_modules: Every P4 planned target plus its transitive local closure; the P3 local runner is not modified.

parameterization.pass_rule: Nonempty declared scenarios and all assertion observations pass; normal_dispatch_attempts=0; negative_fake_attempts>0 and rejected; actual_provider_calls=0; exact bundle hashes unchanged.
parameterization.receipt_reuse: Only identical gate/profile/commit/module/closure/allowlist/scenario/test/runner/verifier tuple; ADMISSION, P3, FIX_BUNDLE, P2_STATE_CONTRACT and STORE_DRIVER receipts never satisfy one another.
